newsitem.title: USA: Chronimed Q2 net climbs on revenue surge.
newsitem.headline: Chronimed Q2 net climbs on revenue surge.

text.p: Chronimed Inc said sharply higher revenues in its Managed Care and Patient Choice segments helped fuel a nine-percent increase in net income in the second quarter ended December 27.
The company reported earnings of $1.8 million, or $0.14 a share, compared to $1.6 million, or $0.12 a share. Revenues were $31.3 million, versus $24.8 million lat year.
Chronimed said Managed Care revenues climbed 80 percent, while Patient Choice revenues grew by 30 percent.
Chronimed provides services and products to chronically ill patients.
